passes.title: Adversarial review and fixes (session 4)
passes.summary: Found and fixed a mislabelled control policy (record and Note said nodes k=4 for a spacing-1 file): run 1 preserved, never published, guarded at publish time by check_variant_policies with a regression test that reproduces the defect. Per-file in-sample/SGMC caveats added; a duplicated word in the control Note fixed; archived portfolios now render as history instead of advice; the upload order was changed to value order (nodes, discovery, control) so the week's slots are not spent on a deliberately weaker file. Reproducibility measured with a third run: identical frozen selection, pixel-identical union-arm files, and a disclosed 116-pixel drift in the discovery arm. Five test/artifact mismatches reconciled to the artefacts; a duplicate DOM id that broke strict locators in the real Chromium suite was fixed with a new invariant test.
